title: Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager
description:
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. We combine deep insight, advanced technology, and close collaboration to help our clients grow, innovate, and deliver measurable value for their customers.

dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever and Metro.

We are looking for Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager who can apply technology to promote the success of our retail clients while addressing business requirements through workflow design, configuring software for optimal client results, and conducting training in accordance with best practices. The Price and Promotion consulting and implementation manager will lead the deployment of dunnhumby’s P&P solutions to new and existing clients. They will work closely with the client’s teams to understand their requirements and ensure that our tools are fit for purpose.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of P&P Products: Ensure the timely and successful delivery of price and promotion software solutions that meet client’s needs and objectives, in line with the project plan. Analyse large and complex datasets to identify potential gaps and inconsistencies during the deployment process.
  • Drive Change: Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with client teams, guiding them through change by implementing new price and promotional processes. Work closely with the product teams to influence the roadmap based on clients’ feedback and develop new features collaboratively.
  • Process & Requirements Documentation: Understand and document the client’s current processes, identify and organize their business and process requirements, and work with the Price & Promotion Consulting Director and the wider team to recommend best-in-class solutions.
  • Software Configuration & Testing: Configure enterprise price and promotions software to align with specific client processes and needs. Develop and implement internal and external testing processes. Perform testing and analysis of data to ensure accuracy and effectiveness of software solutions.
  • GO Live support: Contribute to the successful execution of the GO Live phase by demonstrating the tool’s added value to the client. This involves organizing and participating in client sessions, conducting category analysis, proposing optimal solutions, and monitoring progress through measurement, reporting, and activity tracking.

Required Experience

  • Extensive experience working at a retailer/ FMCG within the Merchandising space and in enterprise software implementations. Specific expertise in Price and Promotions solutions desirable
  • A college degree or equivalent professional experience required
  • Strong business analysis and data analytics skills. Data visualization, advanced Microsoft Excel, programming language a plus
  • Support pre-sales activities and lead generation in coordination with Sales and Client teams to ensure the proper positioning of our P&P solutions to meet clients’ needs.
  • Experience in project management and workflow optimization

What you can expect from us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Facilities Manager
description:
MISSION

Lead and oversee all Facilities operations across Corporate Offices, R&D Labs, Manufacturing Plant, and Distribution Center, ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective infrastructure. Drive operational excellence through strong vendor management, robust maintenance programs, and continuous improvement. Act as the key connection between local operations and global standards for EHS, Engineering, and Sustainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a strong safety culture and full compliance with legal requirements, NRs, company HSE policies, and global corporate standards.
  • Guarantee the integrity, reliability, and availability of all facilities infrastructure, including utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, water treatment, fire protection, building automation, and critical assets.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee internal and outsourced teams (maintenance, cleaning, security, reception, gardening, cafeteria, and services).
  • Manage preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance programs, ensuring uptime and operational continuity for Office, R&D Labs, Manufacturing, and Distribution Center.
  • Oversee facilities services to ensure high service levels, cost efficiency, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives to enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, waste reduction, and operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with certifications, internal audits, external audits, and global standards (ISO, GMP where applicable).
  • Oversee space planning, workplace strategy, building layout updates, and occupancy optimization.
  • Manage construction projects, renovations, expansions, and infrastructure modifications from planning to delivery, ensuring alignment with Capex governance.
  • Coordinate incident management, emergency response plans, fire brigade activities, and building security protocols.
  • Monitor and manage facilities KPIs, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage Opex and Capex budgets, ensuring cost optimization and adherence to financial targets.
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, HR, IT, Security, Finance) to ensure seamless and compliant operations.
  • Ensure vendor management excellence, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for facilities matters with local leadership and global functional teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience managing Facilities operations across multi-site or complex environments (Office, Industrial, Logistics, or R&D).
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, or facilities services.
  • Strong technical background in building systems (HVAC, electrical, utilities, fire systems).
  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance management, vendor management, and project leadership.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.
  • Proven experience in managing Capex and Opex budgets.
  • Experience in multinational environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar clientes em todas as fases do projeto.

  • Demand Planning
  • Supply Planning
  • Production Planning
  • Distribution Planning

  • Garantir a integração eficiente entre OMP, SAP APO e SAP ERP , em colaboração com equipes de TI e negócios.
  • Realizar workshops com stakeholders para levantamento de necessidades e validação de soluções.
  • Ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave e promover boas práticas de planejamento colaborativo.
  • Prestar suporte pós-implantação , identificando oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
  • Analisar métricas de desempenho da cadeia de suprimentos e propor melhorias baseadas em dados.

Perfil Desejado

  • Experiência comprovada em implementação ou suporte a sistemas avançados de planejamento :
  • SAP APO (DP, SNP, PP/DS)
  • OMP (Open Manufacturing Platform) – desejável
  • Outros: Kinaxis, o9, IBP (diferencial)
  • Domínio dos processos de planejamento integrado da cadeia de suprimentos .

title: Agile Coach Senior
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Agile Coach Senior , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

Principais Responsabilidades

  • 1) Kanban – Upstream (Discovery)
  • Estruturar o Kanban upstream para triagem, qualificação e priorização de demanda (intake/triage, option pool, readiness policies).
  • Implementar políticas de entrada (Definition of Ready) e critérios de seleção baseados em capacidade e impacto.
  • Facilitar Upstream Kanban cadences: Replenishment, Strategy Review, Risk Review.
  • Construir classes de serviço, limites de WIP e SLAs de discovery; conectar upstream ao portfólio/OKRs.
  • 2) Kanban – Downstream (Delivery)
  • Modelar fluxos de entrega com estados claros (e.g., design → build → review → deploy → done).
  • Definir WIP, Classes de Serviço (e.g., Expedite, Fixed Date, Standard, Intangible) e Policies explícitas.
  • Medir e melhorar Lead Time, Cycle Time, Throughput, Flow Efficiency e CFD (Cumulative Flow Diagram).
  • Promover cadências: Daily Flow Review, Service Delivery Review, Operations Review e Retrospectivas orientadas a dados.
  • 3) Coaching Multinível (Chapter, Squad, Tribe, Guild)
  • Squads: coaching hands-on; facilitação de cerimônias; remoção de impedimentos sistêmicos; melhoria do fluxo.
  • Chapters: padronização de práticas, políticas e dashboards; trilhas de capacitação; comunidades de prática.
  • Tribes: governança de portfólio com Kanban Flight Levels; gestão de dependências; alinhamento com OKRs.
  • Guilds: curadoria de conteúdo; fóruns de aprendizagem; benchmarks; roadmap de maturidade.
  • 4) Jira – Expert
  • Desenhar e manter Workflows Kanban (estados, transições, validators, conditions, post-functions).
  • Configurar Boards, Swimlanes, Quick Filters, WIP Limits, Card Colors e Automation Rules.
  • Implantar dashboards executivos e operacionais: CFD, Control Chart, Lead Time percentis, Aging WIP, Throughput trends.
  • Governar schemas de issue types, fields (custom), screens, permissions, versioning e integrações (Jira Align/Portfolio, Confluence, Bitbucket, DevOps).
  • Garantir data quality e taxonomias (componentes, labels, epics, initiatives).
  • 5) Métricas, Análise e Melhoria Contínua
  • Construir e monitorar Service Level Expectations (SLEs) com percentis (e.g., P50/P85/P95).
  • Rodar análises de variabilidade, aging work-in-progress e flow debt; conduzir ações de redução.
  • Conectar métricas de fluxo a outcomes de negócio (NPS, adoção, churn, tempo de resposta, satisfação interna).
  • Reportar em ritmos executivos: Health Check por Tribe, trend de previsibilidade, capacidade x demanda.
  • 6) Change Management & Cultura
  • Conduzir jornadas de adoção (mapa de stakeholders, comunicação, treinamento, coaching 1:1).
  • Estabelecer políticas explícitas e acordos de serviço (SLA/SLE, políticas de bloqueio, políticas de revisão).
  • Promover experimentos de melhoria (kaizens) e A3 problem solving.

Mandatory skills:

  • Domínio de Kanban (upstream e downstream) com aplicação prática comprovada em múltiplos times.
  • Experiência atuando em Chapter, Squad, Tribe e Guild (estrutura de Agile at Scale).
  • Jira avançado: workflows, automations, dashboards, control chart, CFD, governance e integrações.
  • Métricas de fluxo: Lead/Cycle Time, Throughput, WIP, CFD, Flow Efficiency, Aging WIP, percentis e SLEs.
  • Facilitação de cadências Kanban e práticas de Service Delivery.
  • Experiência com gestão de dependências e portfólio em ambientes multi-equipes.
  • Habilidade de coaching, comunicação, influência e formação de comunidades.
  • Português fluente; leitura técnica em inglês.

Desirable Skills:

  • Certificações: AKC/AKP/KMP (Kanban University), PSK (Scrum.org), SAFe/Kanban Flight Levels.
  • Experiência com Jira Align, Confluence, Bitbucket/GitHub, Azure DevOps.
  • Background em Data & AI / Produto Digital B2C/B2B, e analytics orientado a valor.
  • Vivência com OKRs, product discovery, service design, SRE/DevOps.
  • Conhecimento em Lean, Theory of Constraints, Cost of Delay e Classes de Serviço avançadas.

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.

You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
  • Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
  • Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
  • Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants

Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

Aqui, performance tem propósito, estrutura tem calor humano e ambição anda junto com ética.

Nosso produto é uma rede social líder no Brasil de monetização de conteúdo, em plena expansão internacional. Esse crescimento exige um(a) Cientista de Dados Pleno com mentalidade analítica, autonomia e capacidade de transformar dados em decisões estratégicas e modelos preditivos de impacto real no negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Data Science , desde a compreensão do problema até a entrega de modelos em produção;
  • Realizar exploração, limpeza e preparação de dados (Data Wrangling) para uso em análises e modelagem;
  • Desenvolver, validar e manter modelos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clustering e séries temporais);
  • Executar análises estatísticas e testes de hipótese (ex: A/B Testing) para validar insights e estratégias;
  • Construir visualizações e relatórios claros e eficazes para comunicação de resultados;
  • Atuar em parceria com times de produto, engenharia e negócios , traduzindo achados técnicos em ações práticas;
  • Participar ativamente da construção de uma cultura orientada a dados , contribuindo com boas práticas e padronizações;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos em produção , garantindo melhoria contínua e rastreabilidade.

O que valorizamos

Raciocínio analítico e curiosidade intelectual: pessoas que questionam, testam hipóteses e buscam compreender profundamente o problema antes de propor soluções.

Foco em impacto: profissionais que entendem o “porquê” por trás dos modelos e direcionam seus esforços para gerar valor real para o negócio.

Autonomia e colaboração: capacidade de conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta, em parceria com engenheiros de dados e áreas de produto.

Comunicação clara: traduzir resultados técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos de forma acessível e objetiva.

Inovação contínua: curiosidade para aprender novas ferramentas e aplicar novas técnicas de ciência de dados e IA.

Requisitos

  • Domínio de Python e suas principais bibliotecas de Data Science (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn);
  • Experiência sólida com SQL para extração, manipulação e análise de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimento prático em Machine Learning aplicado (regressão, classificação, clustering, séries temporais);

Operational Excellence

  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.

  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).

  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.

Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: Customer Operations Specialist
description:
Summary

Sphere is revolutionizing global money movement by building modern financial rails with digital dollars, making transactions simple, affordable, and accessible worldwide. Through our frontend applications, APIs, low-level bank messaging optimizations, and liquidity infrastructure, businesses in emerging markets can send money across borders at scale — without depending on foreign capital or simply speaking the right languages. We combine frontier technology like stablecoins and zero-knowledge proofs with traditional banking, payments, and foreign exchange infrastructure to make global payments settle in minutes.

We’re a Seed+ startup globally distributed across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Singapore, Portugal, and the Caribbean. We’ve processed over $1B in payments volume and are backed by some of the best high-frequency trading and venture firms in the world, including TCG, Jump, Hudson River Trading, and Coinbase; as well as angels from companies like Stripe, PayPal, Brex, Visa, Revolut, Grab, Solana, Circle, and JPMorgan Chase. Our team has previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world’s leading companies (Coinbase, Vanguard, Franklin Templeton, Chainalysis, Wells Fargo) as well as at startups and accelerators like YCombinator. We’re spending the best years of our lives building Sphere, driven by a shared belief in our mission to enhance human prosperity through cutting-edge technology, creating a modern SWIFT for the 21st century and beyond.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the onboarding lifecycle of our enterprise customers, serving as their key liaison and ensuring timely setup
  • Support customers in navigating our Anti-Money Laundering requirements, including Know-Your-Customer and enhanced due diligence checks
  • Drive post-setup customer success with our enterprise customers, helping them unlock the full value of our offerings
  • Build out and manage a robust, multi-channel customer support function (email, chat), to deliver quick and effective resolutions to customer inquiries
  • Work closely with Sales & Product teams to transition customers to new product offerings or vendors
  • Proactively gather and synthesize customer needs and feedback, identifying opportunities for product/UX improvements

Requirements

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and either Spanish or Portuguese
  • Excels at multi-tasking and rapid context switching in fast-paced environments
  • Demonstrated sense of ownership and strong project management & Organizational skills
  • Analytical, with a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills

Nice to haves

  • Prior experience in a customer success, customer onboarding or customer-facing role
  • Prior experience in Compliance, Payments or Web3
  • Knowledge of SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, wire transfers, and other global payment networks.
  • Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) processes, currency conversions, and multi-currency settlement
  • Open to working flexible hours, and extended shifts, to meet business needs

Why Join Us?

  • After years navigating the idea maze, we’ve stumbled on a previously unexplored path to exponentially boost human prosperity and make the world a fairer place. Join us in making a global impact, particularly in emerging regions that are just starting to connect.
  • Have executive level impact, responsibility, and upside in an early-stage startup that has found initial product-market fit and has been growing more than 100% per month over the last year.
  • Work on some of the hardest problems in the world, leveraging frontier technology in cryptography and distributed systems to modernize payments infrastructure from 1959.
  • Unlock exceptional growth and learning opportunities in an environment that champions ownership, ambition, and innovation.
  • Join as an early employee and help us define a world-class culture of collaboration, rationality, low ego/status, customer obsession, and output. There are rare learning opportunities, and you’ll be joining just as we start to scale.

title: Assessor de Investimentos Experiente
description:
Você quer trabalhar em uma Corretora de Valores com plano de carreira bem definido e personalizado, que dê a você todo o suporte necessário para alavancar sua carreira, com regras claras para seu bônus e uma trilha real de crescimento?

Na EQI Investimentos, você encontra uma Corretora focada no atendimento de clientes “Private”, onde seu trabalho é valorizado: remuneração é competitiva, autonomia para negociar, plano de crescimento estruturado, liderança próxima, suporte integral, tecnologia e oportunidades para evoluir na carreira de “Wealth Management” ou empreender para ter seu escritório B2B. Aqui você tem oportunidades sob medida para umas verdadeiras evoluções na sua carreira.

Na EQI, sabemos que seus sonhos são únicos, reconhecemos suas conquistas e oferecemos estrutura real para você ir além.

Candidate-se agora e transforme seu futuro.

Benefícios

  • VA/VR de R$ 1.812

title: Analista de Operações e Controle
description:
Seja bem-vindo(a) à página do Sicoob Engecred!

Há 25 anos no mercado financeiro, o Sicoob Engecred figura entre as maiores cooperativas do Sistema Sicoob, com R$ 4,2 bilhões em ativos totais e cerca de 25 mil cooperados em todas as regiões do país, por meio da associação digital.

Temos em nosso DNA o interesse genuíno pelas pessoas, seja dentro da cooperativa – o que nos levou a conquistar 19 premiações em rankings regionais e nacionais do Great Place to Work (GPTW) -, ou junto aos nossos associados, oferecendo soluções financeiras adequadas e com taxas justas. Isto sem falar nos benefícios que geramos nas comunidades onde atuamos, fomentando negócios e promovendo diversas ações sociais por meio do Instituto Sicoob.

Classificada como A+(bra) pela Fitch Ratings, a instituição tem seus números auditados pela Deloitte. Em 2024, se tornou a primeira cooperativa do Sistema Sicoob, em Goiás, a conquistar a Categoria Plena pelo Banco Central e, também, a obter o selo Empresa Limpa, feitos que reforçam sua credibilidade e postura ética.

Com sede em Goiânia (GO), atualmente possui agências físicas em Goiás e Minas Gerais, além de escritórios de negócios em Betim (MG), Juiz de Fora (MG), Brasília (DF), Campo Grande (MS), Campinas (SP) e São Paulo (SP).

Seguimos em busca de soluções e experiências inovadoras e sustentáveis para, por meio da cooperação, viabilizar o desenvolvimento econômico e social de comunidades.

Junte-se a nós, faça parte desta jornada de sucesso!

Analista de Estratégia Financeira

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em backoffice financeiro , operações estruturadas, asset , banco, securitizadora, DTVM ou administrador fiduciário;
  • Vivência prática com CRA, CRI, FIDC e/ou FII , especialmente em: controle de lastros, acompanhamento de emissões, monitoramento pós-emissão;
  • Experiência com conciliações financeiras e documentais ;
  • Familiaridade com rotinas de auditoria, compliance operacional e governança ;
  • Excel em nível intermediário (controles, conciliações, organização e rastreabilidade de dados);
  • Certificação CEA.

Atividades:

  • Realizar o controle, acompanhamento e validação de lastros relacionados a LCA, LCI, CRA, CRI, FIDC e FII , bem como instrumentos associados (CCIs, recebíveis e contratos);
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade ponta a ponta dos ativos , desde a originação até a liquidação e o acompanhamento pós-emissão;
  • Executar conciliações financeiras, contábeis e documentais dos produtos estruturados;
  • Manter e atualizar checklists operacionais e regulatórios por tipo de produto (CRA, CRI, FIDC e FII);
  • Organizar, validar e custodiar a documentação necessária para auditorias internas, externas e regulatórias ;
  • Atuar como ponto focal operacional junto a: administradores fiduciários, custodiante, auditoria, jurídico, áreas internas;
  • Apoiar os processos de emissão, acompanhamento e monitoramento de CRA, CRI e FIDC , assegurando aderência aos critérios e aprovações vigentes;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento operacional e documental de ativos e fundos imobiliários (FII) , quando aplicável;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento, padronização e melhoria contínua de processos (POPs) e controles da Tesouraria;
  • Identificar, reportar e mitigar riscos operacionais e de lastro , propondo melhorias estruturais de controle .

Benefícios: vale-alimentação/refeição de R$ 2.022,85, vale-transporte, plano de saúde Unimed, plano odontológico Uniodonto, auxílio-creche/babá, bolsa de estudos, seguro de vida, Gympass, Zenklub, previdência privada, adicional por tempo de casa, participação nos resultados e plano de carreira.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas - Máquina de cartão - Mercado Pago - RS
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team

We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.

Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.

Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
Korn Ferry, on behalf of John Deere, a U.S. multinational company and leader in the agricultural and construction machinery industry, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer for a position based in Indaiatuba, SP.

About John Deere & the Role

John Deere is a global technology company providing software and equipment for agriculture, construction, and forestry. With a strong presence in Brazil and Latin America for over 30 years, the company operates key manufacturing sites in São Paulo, Goiás, and Rio Grande do Sul.

For 2025, John Deere is accelerating its focus on autonomous solutions, AI, and connectivity. To support this expansion, John Deere is building a new team in Brazil to develop and scale applications that enhance digital products and services.

As a Senior Software Engineer – Full-Stack (Front-End Heavy), you will primarily contribute to the design and development of modern front-end applications using React, while occasionally working on backend services. You will also have opportunities to work with emerging technologies, including Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (GenAI), to enhance customer-facing applications.

You will leverage technologies like React, APIs, cloud platforms, and AI/GenAI tools to create intuitive, scalable, and secure applications that improve the customer experience.

  • Front-End Development – Build scalable, high-performance front-end applications using React.
  • UI/UX Collaboration – Work closely with designers and product teams to deliver intuitive, customer-centric interfaces.
  • Backend Integration – Contribute to backend development when needed, with a focus on Python or Java (differential).
  • API Development & Integration – Connect front-end solutions with APIs and ensure smooth data flow across platforms.
  • Cloud & DevOps Enablement – Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deployment.
  • Technology Exploration – Evaluate and adopt emerging tools, including ML/GenAI, to drive innovation and improve productivity.
  • Quality & Security by Design – Apply best practices in coding, testing, and security to ensure robust and reliable solutions.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Deliver modern, React-based user interfaces that integrate seamlessly with backend systems.
  • Ensure front-end solutions are scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies and contribute across the stack when necessary.
  • Support the adoption of AI and GenAI to enhance customer-facing applications.
  • Maintain alignment with John Deere’s vision for autonomous operations, AI, and digital optimization.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Must-have: Extensive hands-on experience with React and front-end frameworks.

  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with backend services.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with a focus on user experience.
  • Collaborative mindset, willing to contribute to both front-end and backend tasks.
  • Differential: Experience with Python or Java for backend development.
  • Differential: Experience in Machine Learning (ML) or Generative AI (GenAI) projects.
  • Differential: Exposure to multi-cloud environments or full-stack design patterns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Advanced/Fluent English to collaborate in an international environment.

title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.

The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.

About You

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands-on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
  • Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., CloudWatch, New Relic, PagerDuty)
  • Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaboration
  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform )
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow and Spark

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s data team based in the United States and Hotmart’s data team in Brazil.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job 

In SME credit, advantage compounds through disciplined underwriting, fast learning cycles, and early detection of risks. As our Credit Analyst, you will strengthen our underwriting edge by translating financial data, behavioural signals, and real-world borrower performance into precise credit decisions- while continuously feeding insights back into our core decision models.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct holistic credit analysis for SMEs: financials, cash-flows, tax compliance, bank data, concentration risks, behavioural signals.
  • Produce concise, decision-ready credit memos with recommendations (approve / adjust / decline).
  • Lead periodic reviews of high-exposure borrowers - liquidity evolution, leverage shifts, payment patterns, and macro impacts.
  • Evaluate and recommend credit-limit increases based on performance, updated financials, and risk appetite.
  • Maintain a closed-loop feedback mechanism between underwriting decisions and portfolio outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Data to translate recurring insights into better thresholds, features, and model logic.
  • Support portfolio monitoring with early-warning detection and risk-mitigation recommendations.
  • Ensure underwriting discipline and audit-ready documentation.

Qualifications

  • 2–3 years in IB, credit, structured credit, asset management, DCM or fintech underwriting.
  • Strong financial analysis: liquidity, leverage, coverage, working-capital dynamics, seasonality.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian tax reporting, accounting regimes, and corporate structures.
  • Experience writing clear, investor-grade credit memos.
  • Understanding of credit models (inputs, outputs, sensitivity) and ability to evaluate their strengths/weaknesses.
  • Bonus: exposure to securitisation, structured credit, data-driven underwriting.
  • High analytical rigor and precision in judgment.
  • “Manager of one”- delivers independently with consistency.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, both in English and Portuguese.
  • Proactive in identifying trends, risks, and model improvement opportunities.
  • Thrives in a high-velocity, high-accountability environment.
  • Passion for modernising Brazil’s B2B credit market through technology and transparency.
  • Integrity, long-term thinking, and intellectual honesty.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Itaim Bibi, Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

Somos guiados por atitudes claras, transparentes e de alta performane em nossa rotina, que nos permitem fazer o máximo para nossos clientes, com uma mentalidade overdelivered (entrega mais do que o acordado), com um compromisso inegociável de encantá-los constantemente.

Na SEQ, somos comprometidos com a busca incessante pela excelência. Como líderes no setor de SECONDMENT e RECRUTAMENTO, nos dedicamos a transformar ideias em realidade. Valorizamos a inovação, o compromisso com a qualidade e o desejo de superar expectativas. Se você é apaixonado por desafios e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e inclusiva, junte-se a SEQ nesta jornada emocionante!

Descrição da Posição

Buscamos um Advogado Pleno com sólida experiência no setor de Petróleo e Gás Natural para integrar nosso time jurídico. O profissional atuará em questões regulatórias, contratuais e corporativas, assessorando empresas e stakeholders do setor de energia em operações estratégicas.

Responsabilidades

  • Assessorar em contratos complexos do setor, incluindo Joint Operating Agreements (JOA), Lifting Agreements, contratos de partilha e concessão, contratos de fornecimento e serviços offshore.
  • Atuar em questões regulatórias e compliance, garantindo conformidade com normas da ANP, MME e outros órgãos reguladores.
  • Prestar suporte jurídico em operações societárias, fusões, aquisições e farm-ins/farm-outs.
  • Representar clientes em interações com agências governamentais e tribunais administrativos.
  • Analisar e mitigar riscos jurídicos em projetos de exploração e produção.
  • Participar de negociações estratégicas com players nacionais e internacionais.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Direito.
  • Inglês fluente.
  • Mandarim será um diferencial.
  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência comprovada no setor de Petróleo e Gás, especialmente em questões regulatórias, contratuais e corporativas.
  • Conhecimento da legislação aplicável ao setor, incluindo Lei do Petróleo (Lei nº 9.478/1997), Lei da Partilha (Lei nº 12.351/2010) e regulamentos da ANP.
  • Experiência com contratos upstream e downstream.
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro (modelo híbrido de trabalho).
  • Capacidade analítica, comunicação assertiva e perfil estratégico.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação, LL.M ou certificações internacionais na área de Petróleo e Gás, Direito Empresarial ou Regulação.
  • Experiência com licitações e contratos com a Administração Pública.
  • Vivência no ambiente corporativo.
  • Conhecimento de aspectos jurídicos em acordos e parcerias com empresas chinesas será um diferencial.

Você é essa pessoa? Estamos ansiosos para te conhecer!

THINK SEQ!

title: Coordenador(a) de TI Sistemas - Negócios
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares de TI na área de sistemas;
  • Propor soluções tecnológicas que melhorem os processos;
  • Garantir que os sistemas e soluções de TI sejam integrados de forma eficaz entre as diferentes áreas, respeitando a metodologia de TI Corporativa Global;
  • Coordenar recursos de TI, incluindo pessoas e orçamento (Capex e Opex) para assegurar que as operações sejam realizadas de forma eficiente;
  • Monitorar, suportar e avaliar o desempenho das soluções de TI implementadas, utilizando métricas para medir a eficácia e propor melhorias;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a alta administração para alinhar as iniciativas de TI com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.

Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável Especialização em Gestão de Projetos;
  • Conhecimento avançado no ERP SAP (em todos os seus módulos) e sistemas satélites;
  • Experiência anterior em cargos de coordenação ou gestão dentro de ambientes de TI, com foco em projetos que envolvem múltiplas áreas;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de informação, gerenciamento de projetos, metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de colaboração e BI;
  • Desejável ter atuado anteriormente em empresas do ramo da celulose;
  • Mandatório ter Espanhol e Inglês intermediário;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Curitiba, São Paulo ou Três Lagoas;
  • Carteira de Habilitação;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (QA Team)
description:
⚙️ Senior Platform / DevOps Engineer (Enterprise Enablement and QA)

About StackGuardian

At StackGuardian , we’re building the future of secure, compliant, and developer-first cloud orchestration . Our platform enables enterprises to automate infrastructure safely across AWS, Azure, and GCP and bringing together DevOps speed, security guardrails, and platform governance.

We’re looking for a Platform / DevOps Engineer based in Brazil who thrives at the intersection of infrastructure, quality, user experience, and enterprise adoption . This role goes beyond pure DevOps - you’ll help validate features at scale, influence product design, and work directly with beta and platform users.

What You’ll Do

  • Build & Operate the Platform: Design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines using Terraform , CloudFormation , Ansible , GitHub Actions , Docker , and Kubernetes across AWS and Azure.
  • Enterprise-Scale Validation: Work closely with the QA team to test new platform features, workflows, and integrations under realistic enterprise-scale scenarios — performance, security, reliability, and compliance.
  • Enable Product & UX Decisions: Partner with Product and UX teams to provide hands-on technical feedback on new features, workflows, and usability — ensuring designs work in real-world cloud environments.
  • Customer & Beta Engagement: Set up demos, reference architectures, and proof-of-concepts; present solutions to beta users and platform customers , and incorporate feedback into product improvements.
  • Reliability & Observability: Implement monitoring, alerting, and SRE best practices to ensure platform stability, scalability, and operational excellence.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 4+ years in DevOps, Platform, or SRE roles, preferably supporting enterprise SaaS platforms .
  • IaC Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform , CloudFormation , and Ansible .
  • CI/CD Mastery: Proven ability to design and maintain pipelines using GitHub Actions , Jenkins , or similar platforms.
  • Cloud Expertise: Solid experience with AWS (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway) and working knowledge of Azure .
  • Containers & Orchestration: Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Quality & Validation Mindset: Comfort working with QA teams, test environments, and validating features before enterprise rollout.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to explain complex infrastructure concepts clearly to QA, UX, product, and customer-facing teams.
  • Bonus: Experience with security tooling, policy-as-code, compliance workflows, or developer platforms.

Why Join Us

  • You will shape the core architecture of the platform.
  • You’ll have ownership, autonomy, and a real voice in product direction.
  • High-trust culture: direct collaboration with founders, zero needless bureaucracy.
  • Innovation Time: dedicated days for experimentation, architectural research, and prototyping.

Let’s shape the Future of Platform Engineering together!

title: Especialista em finanças de TI
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Especialista em Finanças de TI

Estamos buscando profissionais para atuar na área de Soluções Empresariais que transformar sua carreira na TCS.

Responsabilidades:

Análise e Arquitetura de Dados

Main Responsibilities

  • Garantir o alinhamento financeiro: Assegurar que os custos de projetos e operações de TI estejam dentro do budget aprovado e alinhados com a visão estratégica da empresa.
  • Validar novos produtos e tecnologias: Realizar a análise de viabilidade financeira (TCO - Total Cost of Ownership) para novas ferramentas, serviços de nuvem ou contratações de software antes da aquisição.
  • Análise de Dados e Relatórios: Executar análises detalhadas de billing (faturamento), gerar relatórios de variação orçamentária (Budget vs. Actual) e fornecer insights acionáveis para a liderança.
  • Integração com Arquitetura: Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos de solução para estimar custos de futuros projetos e migrações, garantindo design-to-cost .
  • Garantir Escalabilidade e Qualidade: Assegurar que os modelos de controle financeiro sejam escaláveis para acompanhar o crescimento da nuvem e mantenham padrões de auditoria/compliance rigorosos.
  • Transferência de Conhecimento: Apoiar equipes técnicas com expertise corporativa em finanças, educando engenheiros sobre o impacto financeiro de suas decisões técnicas.

Competências Técnicas:

  • Inglês Fluente (Mandatório): Comunicação verbal e escrita avançada para reportar-se a stakeholders globais.
  • FinOps & Cloud Cost Management: Experiência comprovada em gestão de custos em nuvem (Azure/AWS), incluindo Reserved Instances , Savings Plans e Tagging Strategy .
  • Contabilidade de TI (IT Controlling): Domínio de conceitos de CAPEX vs. OPEX, depreciação de ativos e alocação de custos ( Chargeback/Showback ).
  • SAP ERP: Conhecimento sólido nos módulos financeiros do SAP (FICO, PS - Project Systems) e integração com compras (MM) para rastreio de pedidos de TI.
  • Ferramentas de BI e Excel: Excel Avançado (VBA/Macros é um plus) e Power BI para construção de dashboards financeiros automatizados.
  • Experiência Sênior: Mínimo de 5-8 anos em funções financeiras, com foco específico em Tecnologia da Informação ou Telecom.

Formação:

  • Certificações FinOps: FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) é um grande diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de Arquitetura Enterprise: Entendimento de como decisões de infraestrutura afetam a estrutura de custos (ex: Serverless vs. VM).
  • Ferramentas de Gestão de Custos: Experiência com ferramentas de mercado como Apptio, CloudHealth ou Azure Cost Management nativo.
  • Métodos Ágeis: Familiaridade com frameworks ágeis (Scrum/SAFe) e como adaptar o planejamento financeiro tradicional para ciclos ágeis (Lean Budgeting).
  • Automação: Noções de Python ou PowerShell para automatizar a coleta de dados de faturas ou integração de APIs de billing.
  • Negociação: Experiência prévia em negociação direta de contratos de software (Enterprise Agreements) com grandes vendors (Microsoft, Oracle, SAP).

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.

We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.

As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.

The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.

Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.

The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of "brand recognizes brand" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.

What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency

Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow "show-don't-tell" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency

You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention

You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)

What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency

How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:

When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  1. Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  2. A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.

We're excited to meet you!

title: Inside Sales Representative
description:
Inside Sales Representative

Location: Sao Paulo- Remote

Type: Full-Time

About the Role

Are you a driven sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment? Do you love building relationships, identifying opportunities, and closing deals? If so, BSI Americas is looking for you!

We're on the lookout for a Bilingual Inside Sales Representative (English & Portuguese) who’s passionate about helping organizations grow through high-quality assurance services and solutions. If you’re motivated, organized, and enjoy collaborating across teams, this could be your next career move.

In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Drive Growth: Propose and close new contracts, meet and exceed revenue goals, and ensure client satisfaction in your territory.
  • Build Relationships: Engage with key decision-makers at small to mid-sized organizations to understand their needs and align our services to support their goals.
  • Prospect Like a Pro: Use a blended approach of outreach—social media, email, cold calling, and more—to grow and manage your sales funnel.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with marketing and field sales to identify new opportunities and cross-sell within existing accounts.
  • Stay Organized & Informed: Maintain accurate sales data in Salesforce and stay up to date on our full suite of services.

To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree (BBA preferred).
  • At least 2 years of experience in a consultative inside sales role.
  • 1+ year of experience selling assurance services (a plus!).
  • Proven ability to meet/exceed sales quotas and close deals with confidence.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools like Salesforce, plus the Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to adapt and apply a structured sales methodology.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and verbal).

What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, health, vision, dental and life insurance, pension plan with company contribution, short-term and long-term disability, pregnancy and parental leave, registered savings plan, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout out our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.
